title: TPNCP:  Add preference for tpncp.dat path
description:
Flexibility is needed in where the database file can be loaded from.
Add a preference so the user has complete control over where it's loaded from instead of requiring it be in the data directory (which requires admin privileges to edit or replace).

notes.body: @AndersBroman sorry, I totally forgot about this. :smile:
Is it worth mentioning that it is shipped with Wireshark in directory tpncp?

This is change that breaks backwards compatibility.  Minimally the "load_db" preference has to be marked as obsolete to prevent "noise" when starting Wireshark.
The "old" way was easier because users needed less knowledge of the "configuration". That's partially why I went with !22713 implementation.
This "new" way is cleaner from a code perspective, but I don't want to end up with confused users (yes at least minimally mention that the tpncp.dat file can be found in the Wireshark directory)
Sure, I'll keep it. Thank you!

I think that it would work better if TPNCP used `proto_register_prefix()`, so that the fields were only loaded when someone first tried to filter with them or encountered them in a capture file, because it's a pretty decent start up cost due to the text file processing. That would also make it possible to start Wireshark and change the path location in the preferences without having to necessarily restart (if they hadn't been loaded yet).
